what: On the right end of the black pill button, a 6px orange dot stretches into a 20×2px horizontal bar over .3s on hover, and an arrowhead (2px chevron) lights up at the tip. On release it returns to the dot over the same duration.

options.--fx-shift: Distance (css) it is pushed to the right as it grows, default 0 — used when the original keeps the dot away from the right edge and the bar extends further out (8px in the original)
options.look: With bare, only the bar with no arrowhead (Name)
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Dot (child, empty element) — placed after the button text
options.--fx-color: Dot and arrow color (css), default var(--kf-accent)

from.where: index.html .su-btn ”view more” button (original Button-module buttonPrimaryDot — transition all .3s, :hover 20×2 + :after chevron opacity)
Blue button .mt-btn ”View more” on every page (original .btn a::before — white dot at right 32px 5px, on hover becomes 16×1px at right 24px, transition all .4s ease-out, no arrowhead)
